findings.title: Evaluator accepts non-answers and unsupported assertions
findings.impact: CANON pass counts and SENTINEL quality gates can accept outputs that do not satisfy the question or invent facts. Existing tests missed these false positives.

findings.requested_fix: Require expected claim content, actual supported conflict claims, and a recognized conservative abstention contract; add adversarial tests and rerun reports.

findings.title: Persisted vectors and cache ignore encoder configuration identity
findings.impact: Changing prefixes or other embedding configuration at the same model revision can silently mix old passage vectors with new query vectors; thresholds and semantic entries likewise remain eligible.

probe.kind: controlled encoder configuration-invalidation probe, not a real model measurement

findings.requested_fix: Key passage vectors, answer-cache namespaces and calibration by both model revision and encoder configuration fingerprint; test a changed configuration across new instances.

findings.title: Advertised Python package entrypoint has no usable installed distribution
findings.impact: pyproject exposes a console script but supplies neither runtime dependencies nor required configs/datasets/web resources. Resource paths assume the source checkout.
findings.requested_fix: Either support and test wheel installation with packaged resources and external writable runtime, or explicitly declare checkout-only support and remove the misleading packaging entrypoint. Checkout-only is acceptable for this local-lab scope.

strengths: Six laboratories have real separate responsibilities: retrieval, durable workflow, paired regression gating, trace diagnosis, guarded answer reuse, and evidence evaluation. They share contracts and a small local stack coherently.

Meaningful negative tests cover stale approval, artifact corruption, scope revocation, prompt-injection-like source text, malformed tools, concurrent resume, private export boundaries and intentional candidate corruption.
Reports distinguish fixtures, real local embeddings, live and replay; unknown costs remain null; no generative quality or commercial impact claim is fabricated.
Saved failures, case-level outputs, corpus hashes and explicit synthetic/public provenance make shortcomings inspectable.
limitations: Same-session independent agent review, not an external human audit or independent organization endorsement. No paid provider calls or publication.
No remote Linux CI execution observed. CI uses exact version locks but no integrity hashes and GitHub action major tags; dependency resolution was not independently reproduced from an empty cache.
Public same-author synthetic questions and inspected test splits cannot establish unseen-task model reliability. Original benchmark has 29/32 passes, not a held-out validation.
LENS diagnosis largely classifies known error labels and controlled injections; RELAY is a bounded workflow. These are legitimate mechanisms but not measured general agent autonomy.
Code uses compact one-line statements and broad untyped dict interfaces; static-check success is not strict type coverage. Large service modules and shared path globals raise maintenance costs.
No independent browser or real-encoder rerun in this initial review; existing local/browser evidence was read, not relabeled as newly executed.

top_three_material_improvements.improvement: Close evaluator loopholes before optimizing pass counts.
top_three_material_improvements.acceptance: The three independent adversarial outputs fail; valid existing cases still evaluate; public reports are regenerated under a new recorded evaluator/code fingerprint.

top_three_material_improvements.improvement: Make configuration changes invalidate computed state.
top_three_material_improvements.acceptance: Changing only encoder configuration forces passage recomputation, semantic cache misses and new calibration; restart reuse still works for an unchanged configuration.

top_three_material_improvements.improvement: Make delivery and evidence reproducible at the claimed scope.
top_three_material_improvements.acceptance: Declare one supported installation route, exercise it from a clean copy, keep CI locks synchronized, bind final reports to final sources, and label visible regression fixtures separately from genuinely new evaluation cases.

final.scope: Direct recheck of this review agent's three original findings only. This is not whole-project final validation; Atlas quality work and final delivery reports/documentation are still being completed by the integrator.
final.assessment: The observed evaluator and encoder-state defects are repaired in the checked source. Removing the misleading package entrypoint and explicitly defining checkout-only distribution is an appropriate scope decision for these local labs. This is a credible engineering demonstration with bounded claims; broader model-quality and production-readiness conclusions remain unsupported.

findings.evidence: All three original false-positive inputs now fail; source-faithful supported/conflict/refusal controls still pass. Evaluator version is canon-evidence-checks/2.
findings.limitation: Exact annotated source coverage and a canonical refusal template establish this extractive contract, not general natural-language entailment.

findings.evidence: Changing only encoder configuration reencodes passages and changes answer-cache/calibration identity. Reopened store with unchanged configuration reuses passage vectors and preserves expected scores.
findings.limitation: Recheck uses controlled vectors. It is a state-invalidation test, not a new real-model quality measurement.

findings.evidence: pyproject no longer declares a build backend, distributable project or console script and explicitly documents checkout application use. Existing Makefile/PYTHONPATH route remains the supported interface.
findings.follow_up: Integrator must propagate checkout-only support into final README/delivery wording. No functional wheel-installation claim is made.
